scientific_integrity: General proof from integral pair sequences and a complex-conjugation half-degree lemma. Standard-library finite Smith-determinantal checks are supplementary and cannot prove the infinite claim. Publication priority was checked against targeted accessible primary sources and mathematical research records, not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a totally real arrangement of rational plane curves with split real P1 normalizations and even component degrees. Determines the exact cokernel order and its short exact sequence but not the extension class if the real embedding character is nonzero; does not address non-totally-real curves, positive-genus normalizations, or global classification of possible embedding characters. Results have not been independently verified.
title: The integral chamber lattice for even-degree totally real rational plane curves
